newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's Nan Fung to set HK$700 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: HK's Nan Fung to set HK$700 mln credit facility.

text.p: A HK$700 million revolving credit facility for Nan Fung Finance Ltd is expected to be launched this week, bankers said.
The deal will be guaranteed by the borrower's parent company, Nan Fung Textiles Consolidated Ltd.
It is also secured by mortgages over an office building in Hong Kong.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with annual put options. It pays a margin of 65 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier manager is expected to be about 90 basis points.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate funding.
Tokai Bank, Deutsche Bank and Development Bank of Singapore are arranging the transaction.
